messages:
Alex M.: Morning team — quick async canary check for the v2 routing change.
Alex M.: Deployed slice to prod at 3% (model-pool-1:2%, model-pool-2:1%). Observability: latency stable but model-pool-2 showing a small bump in 5xxs since 09:05 UTC.
rollout-bot: Canary update: v2-rollout -> 3% (2026-03-17T09:12:05Z).
Priya S.: saw that spike. Can you paste the metric query you used? I want to compare across regions.
Alex M.: quick p95 query I ran in grafana:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/infer",status=~"5.."}[2m])) by (instance)
```
Alex M.: most 5xxs coming from pod model-pool-2-7c8f
Jamal R.: grabbing traces now. @Mei any config in the runtime that could cause a regression at low traffic? memory/kv cache warmups?
Mei L.: nothing new in the runtime flags for this release. Could be cache cold starts on pool-2 — those pods got restarted 8m ago per kube events.
Carlos V.: ff name is `ff_routing_v2_prod`. We can nudge traffic away from pool-2 by changing the slice weight. I can do a temporary traffic-split if you want.
Priya S.: please do +1. Move from model-pool-2 -> model-pool-1 until we confirm traces. Keep total at 3%.
Carlos V.: on it — running patch now:
```
# ephemeral: adjust weights
redwoodctl rollout adjust --flag ff_routing_v2_prod --slice model-pool-2=0.3,model-pool-1=0.7
```
Carlos V.: done. rollout-bot: Canary slice weights updated (2026-03-17T09:19:12Z).
Alex M.: thanks. I'm watching latency & errors. If 5xxs don't fall in 10m we rollback to 0%.
Jamal R.: traces pulled — saw increased upstream time for model-pool-2 pod during a GC spike. capturing trace ids and posting shortly.
Mei L.: noting a follow-up: add a probe on preflight cache-warm path; file a small checklist item so next canary includes a warm-up hook.
Alex M.: action items: Priya verify cross-region parity, Carlos adjusted weights, Jamal to attach traces, Mei to add warmup checklist, I'll re-evaluate at +15m and then decide rollback vs ramp.
Priya S.: ack. Will validate and post a quick summary in 10.
Alex M.: :thumbsup:
